rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when referring to a famous person.

example.english: That celebrity is on TV all the time.
example.jyutping: go2 go3 ming4 sing1 seng4 jat6 soeng6 din6 si6

rows.note: Use this when referring to fame or how well-known someone is rather than to the person.

example.english: Their celebrity has grown a lot lately.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gan6 paai4 ming4 hei3 daai6 zo2 hou2 do1
